Messages.Author: Mike Kelly
Messages.Body:
If I FoM leaving the interceptor tapped and the interceptor untaps or wakes,
does the interceptor still have any intercept left or is it reset to 0.

Messages.Author: The Corrupter
Messages.Body:
In article <4eu01q$h...@butch.lmsc.lockheed.com>, Mike Kelly
<kelly_...@mm.ssd.lmsc.lockheed.com> wrote:

> If I FoM leaving the interceptor tapped and the interceptor untaps or wakes,
> does the interceptor still have any intercept left or is it reset to 0.

I would say that you are still resolving the same action, and thus any
minion has the same status as it held previously. I could be wrong... :)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Mike Kelly <kelly_...@mm.ssd.lmsc.lockheed.com> writes:

>If I FoM leaving the interceptor tapped and the interceptor untaps or wakes,
>does the interceptor still have any intercept left or is it reset to 0.

All minions keep all intercept/stealth bonuses until the end of the action,
as stated in the rulebook.
